title: Composition Design of a Novel High-Temperature Titanium Alloy Based on Data Augmentation Machine Learning.
summary: A model-selected quinary titanium alloy was fabricated and tested at high temperature; measured tensile strength agreed with prediction. General materials result, without application-readiness claims.
